responsibility: Implements early and late warnings for uses of uninitialized and maybe-uninitialized variables on GIMPLE SSA. It detects undefined SSA names and PHI-derived potentially undefined values, uses dominance, post-dominance, edge executability, and predicate analysis to relate guarded uses to guarded definitions, suppresses false positives in special cases, and emits both unconditional and predicate-aware maybe-uninitialized diagnostics at the appropriate stage of the optimization pipeline.
